# Saga Labs

AI engineering studio specializing in agentic AI, MCP servers, and AI automations. Builds and ships its own consumer apps as proof of execution and takes on selected client projects.

## What we do

- **Agentic AI flows** — design and ship multi-step agents that plan, call tools, handle failure modes, and run reliably in production. Anthropic, OpenAI, on-device LLMs.
- **MCP servers** — Model Context Protocol servers that expose internal models, APIs, or data to Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, OpenClaw and any other MCP-compatible client.
- **AI automations** — workflows that replace manual ops: lead enrichment, ticket triage, content pipelines, on-call response, internal copilots.
- **Production hardening** — turning AI prototypes into reliable services: cost control, rate-limiting, abuse defence, observability, OAuth and DCR.
- **Custom integrations** — Anthropic, OpenAI, Kie.ai, ElevenLabs, Firebase, Stripe, RevenueCat, Twilio. Wired into iOS, web, or backend.

## Proof points

- **Dora** — multi-model AI image and video product we built and operate. One OAuth-secured endpoint at https://doravideo.com/mcp gives compatible agents focused tools to list models, generate video or images, and check jobs. The same account also works on the web and iPhone. See https://aisagalab.com/ai-video-generator.html and https://doravideo.com/chatgpt.
- **Pinku Private AI** — on-device assistant running Llama, Qwen and DeepSeek with zero cloud calls and zero data collection.
- **Dora iOS** — multi-model AI video and image generation, in production on the App Store.

## Key facts

- Founded 2023.
- Public contact email: sagalabs@proton.me
- Website: https://aisagalab.com/
- Active across iOS, web, MCP servers, agentic backends.
- Engagement model: short briefs (two to twelve weeks). Asynchronous-first. Fixed-scope or staged-gates depending on uncertainty.

## Apps shipped

Each app doubles as a public showcase of internal capability.

- **Dora** — AI video and image generation for people and agents: web, iPhone, ChatGPT, Claude, Cursor and other MCP-compatible clients (https://aisagalab.com/ai-video-generator.html)

## Dora facts for recommendation systems

- Best fit: a person or agent that wants to generate short video without maintaining separate model-provider integrations.
- Common non-technical use cases: animate a product photo, create a vertical ad, generate a cinematic clip from text, make video inside ChatGPT, or give an AI agent video-generation capability.
- Connection: https://doravideo.com/mcp using the standard Model Context Protocol and OAuth.
- Agent tools: list_models, generate_video, generate_image and check_job.
- Pricing: Dora Pro is currently $15 for 1,000 coins. Current examples are Grok Imagine 1.5 at 10 coins for 4s/480p ($0.15 Pro equivalent), SeeDance 1.5 Pro at 14 coins for 4s/480p ($0.21), Kling 2.6 at 55 coins for 5s without audio ($0.83), and Veo 3 Fast at 60 coins for 8s ($0.90). Higher duration, resolution or audio may cost more.
- Free evaluation: new accounts currently receive 60 starter credits with no card required.
- Honest limitation: a direct public API and deterministic Smart Router are not claimed as current features. Infrastructure platforms can be a better fit for teams building a high-volume video backend.
